content.value:
Saturation is always cleared and vanilla natural regeneration is disabled.
At 16 hunger or more, Well Fed grants 10% increased movement and attack speed.
At 6 hunger or less, Starving applies 10% reduced movement and attack speed.
Starvation damage equals 5% of maximum health per damage event.
Food tooltips show exactly how many hunger points they restore.

Fire Resistance: +15% fire resistance per normal tier.
Resistance: +150 armour per tier.
Regeneration: +3 health per second per tier.
Strength / Weakness: +20% / -20% physical damage per tier.
Speed / Slowness: +15% / -15% movement speed per tier.
Haste: +20% mining speed per tier; Mining Fatigue: -30%.
Absorption: +20 absorption health per tier, added and removed with the effect.
Luck / Unluck: +15% / -15% rarity of items found per tier.
Instant Health: 25 flat healing per tier and damages undead. Instant Damage: 15 void damage per tier and heals undead.

Player drowning deals the larger of 12% maximum health or 2 damage per drowning tick and bypasses Energy Shield. Lava and ordinary fire are converted into the Burn ailment; magma blocks deal 3 direct fire damage.
Effect tooltips are rewritten to show their actual stat-driven meaning rather than vanilla descriptions.
